description: Make a free dynamic QR code on Foundaree for the signed-in user. The QR holds a fixed Foundaree link (foundaree.com/r/...), so the user can change where it goes later without printing it again. Use it when the user wants a QR code for a menu, shop, flyer, card, event or any link. Returns the QR image (show it to the user), the scan link inside the QR, and a page where they can download it as PNG or SVG for printing. Scanning needs no app or account. Needs the user to have connected their Foundaree account.

link.description: Where the QR should open: a full web address (https://...). Only http and https links work.

name.description: A short name only the user sees, e.g. "Cafe menu".

name: create_qr_code
title: Make a free QR code
